summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration with Spark 4.1, enhancements to metadata handling, and proposals for improving the REST specification. Notable topics include the addition of a 404 response for the /v1/config endpoint and a patch release for pyiceberg-core addressing missing Python 3.12 wheels.
highlights: Iceberg-Spark integration work and async reader improvements
Proposal to add 'Attributes' field to Iceberg V4
Discussion on adding 404 response for /v1/config endpoint
Patch release 0.9.1 for pyiceberg-core addressing Python 3.12 wheels
